summary: Teófilo Braga (1843–1924) was a writer and republican politician who headed the provisional government proclaimed with the Republic in October 1910, until the Constituent Assembly elected a president in 1911, and who held the presidency again for five months in 1915, elected by Congress to serve out Manuel de Arriaga’s term. He is in the atlas as the first and the third of the Republic’s heads of state.
